title: please some suggestions or solution for wrong readings
body:
I really need some help and possible suggestions, solutions. 
Currently using xdrip with miaomiao on international libre 14 days on a note 9 android version 9. Latest stable release as pushed by automatic updates. Everything was fine until 2 sensors ago. Now levels are totally wrongly reported, differences of over 100 between blood, libre scanner and xdrip. Did not change no settings.
Should I reset (data and cache) xdrip??? Re install?? Calibration is done as usually twice at beginning and every 12 hours possibly during flat state but now I have to calibrate way more often specially because I have to check my real levels since this discrepancy started. Please help. Could it be MiaoMiao???

I don't think that it is related to some hw or sw problem other in the sensor it self.
You need to make sure that you are calibrating only when:
1) BG is stable.
2) not after a meal.
I believe this should solve the problem.

If you still want to move to a mode without calibrations, and have results very close to the one that are received on the reader, this can also be done.
You need to install something that is called OOP algorithm from: https://drive.google.com/file/d/18zkgZq3ztNlgQZovKcE7ddO70PuawfBB/view?usp=drivesdk 
and then enable it on xdrip:
On xdrip go to setting->less common settings->other misc options-> and set out of process blukon algorithm. (If this option is disabled, this means that your version of xDrip is too old).
